Original TrueType files and SHA-256:

LXGWWenKaiLite-Regular.ttf
140c99ba4e28e817cec49bf82a0c5fcdc4fe633fb9dfda16d0ee8d59a8545f15

LXGWWenKaiLite-Medium.ttf
02eb0f8deed11b00481393f5720630ae1a44424f37f4157ea160a69a1c72a0b6

The bundled WOFF2 files are format-converted, Unicode-partitioned subsets
created solely for webfont delivery. They retain the original 400 and 500
OS/2 weight classes. No glyph outlines were intentionally redesigned.

The official family also provides Light 300. This theme does not bundle it
because no current theme role uses that weight and including an unused third
font would exceed QingYu's 16 MiB compressed theme-import limit.

The upstream OFL.txt, including its Reserved Font Name additional permission
for WOFF/WOFF2 webfont subsets, is preserved as FONT-LICENSE.txt.
